findings.finding: Positive integer CLI preserves default; fractional, malformed, missing, zero and negative values reject.
Divisibility rejects after runtime/model setup; error wording reverses divides/divisible-by. Predicate is correct; neither location nor message was introduced by patch.
Logged loss is smoothed rank0 last-microbatch loss, not full-update/global mean. Gradient uses every microbatch.
Explicit batch ramp overrides accumulation and can scale LR; no-scaling conclusion requires intended batch-ramp OFF.
Optional byte-weight loss averages separately normalized microbatches, not a single global byte-weighted ratio; intended ordinary-token mean unaffected.
Weight-only checkpoint omits total batch and optimizer/RNG/loader state; load is warm start, not exact resume. Patch preserves schema.
